verdict.rationale: Selective skill installation is a fair question for a skills collection, but the documented install paths (`/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`, `devin plugins install obra/superpowers`, git clone for Hermes) install the whole Superpowers plugin. The evidence never describes picking individual skills from the 20+ bundled ones. The README's framing that skills simply trigger automatically once installed also points to an all-in-one bundle rather than per-skill selection.
